name: Canter Resources Corp.
summary: Canter Resources Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and evaluation of resource properties in Canada and the United States. The company explores for lithium and boron deposits. It holds interests in the Railroad Valley Lithium-Boron project located in Nye County, Nevada; Beaver Creek property comprising lithium occurrences located in the town of Lincoln, Montana, USA; and Puzzle Lake property located in Saskatchewan, Canada. The company was formerly known as Canter Capital Corp. and changed its name to Canter Resources Corp. in November 2021. Canter Resources Corp. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
